title: Alabama U.S. Citizen Says ICE Detained Him Three Times
description_medium: ProPublica reported in May 2026 that Leo Garcia Venegas, a U.S. citizen and construction worker in Alabama, had been detained by immigration agents for a third time. He said agents shackled him after stopping him outside his home, despite his citizenship claim. Earlier encounters occurred while he filmed his brother’s arrest and at a worksite. Venegas is challenging the detentions in federal court.
description_long: Leo Garcia Venegas, a U.S. citizen and construction worker in coastal Alabama, said immigration agents detained him for a third time on May 2, 2026. According to his account, officers stopped him outside his home, pulled him from his truck and shackled him before releasing him after verifying his identity. Venegas had already described two 2025 encounters: agents tackled him while he filmed his brother’s arrest at a construction site, and officers later questioned his citizenship at another worksite after he showed an Alabama REAL ID. He became the lead plaintiff in a federal lawsuit challenging immigration stops and detentions. ProPublica’s May report placed the third detention against the background of those earlier incidents and the pending case. The claims about each encounter remain disputed and are part of ongoing litigation. Venegas’s case drew attention to how immigration agents verify citizenship when people are present during enforcement actions, particularly at construction sites where workers may be bystanders or witnesses. The lawsuit places the encounters within a broader dispute over how immigration agents identify people during worksite enforcement and what limits apply when citizens are caught up in those operations.

corrected_wording.original_claim: Original headline labels the encounters racial profiling as an established legal finding.
corrected_wording.corrected_claim: Venegas, a U.S. citizen, reported three separate immigration-agent detentions and challenged the stops in pending litigation.

source_access_notes: Reviewed ProPublica’s May 2026 report on Leo Garcia Venegas’s third detention and lawsuit: https://www.propublica.org/article/immigration-leo-garcia-venegas-arrests-detentions-citizens-ice-dhs.
rationale: Removed the closing general legal-caveat sentence and replaced it with context about the lawsuit and enforcement issue raised by the reported encounters.
